all_arm_sources_exist.why: a missing arm means the holdout would be spent on an incomplete comparison

config_freeze_exists.why: the freeze is the holdout lock: it pins every hash, parameter and rule so that nothing can be tuned once holdout results are visible

development_controls_separate.why: fairness, scoring and statistics controls must all have fired on development data; a control that never separated has verified nothing

development_seal_valid.why: the seal is what distinguishes development titles from holdout titles; without it there is no such thing as an untouched title

fairness_contract_holds.why: the arms must differ only in knowledge representation

full_repository_green.why: a red repository means the harness that produces the endpoint is not known to work

holdout_status_unopened.why: a holdout that has been opened once cannot be opened again as a holdout

identity_controls_separate.why: the identity chain must be able to reach every failure state it claims: reconciled, mismatch, not-ready and ambiguous

leakage_gates_live.why: both leakage layers must have demonstrated they can fail

model_identity_chain_reconciled.why: the candidate registry's expected revision, the live attestation and the config freeze must be the same revision. MODEL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH means something ran that was not expected: the registry is not overwritten with whatever ran, and the holdout does not open

model_is_pinned_and_real.why: the development model performs no inference. Opening the holdout against it would spend untouched titles on a stub

model_runtime_attested.why: MODEL_RUNTIME_NOT_READY otherwise. A model name pins nothing: two runtimes serving the same name can differ in checkpoint, tokenizer, quantization and serving stack. Every field must come from the live runtime. There is no fallback to another model --- an unattestable runtime fails the preflight

no_fallback_model_permitted.why: the serving registry may declare a fallback recipe, which is correct for serving and forbidden here. A confirmatory run that silently answered from a different model would be unfalsifiable

no_source_drift.why: the code that runs the holdout must be the code that was frozen, byte for byte

overlap_guard_live.why: the generator must read the key the seal actually uses, verified against the source rather than assumed

raw_context_budget_policy_decided.why: the development run measured RAW losing the oracle to truncation on 0.5763 of questions. Until the policy is chosen and stated, a context-window effect would be reported as a representation effect

raw_context_window_known.why: option B gives RAW the whole document pair against the frozen model context. Without the attested context window RAW cannot run, and falling back to the retrieval budget would reintroduce the budget-limited floor

scorer_exists.why: scoring must be defined before the arms run, never chosen after seeing them

separability_metric_disposition_decided.why: at 1.0 the metric is tautological under the v8 admission rule; it must be declared a generator integrity check or replaced before the holdout, never cited as independent difficulty evidence

statistics_config_exists.why: the multiplicity correction is frozen before the holdout, not selected to suit the result

v7_titles_present_in_seal.why: the overlap guard reads this list. An empty list makes the guard inert and a silent pass, which is worse than no guard --- exactly the defect found on 2026-08-19

controls.note: the baseline is synthetic so the controls fire regardless of the live state. overlap_guard_live still reads the real generator source, because a control that can fake a live guard is not a control.

what_this_reads: development-side state only. No holdout title is opened, read, inspected, previewed or dry-run by this gate.
